value.name: Self-Generation Incentive Program — Residential Solar and Storage Equity, storage component (waitlisted)
value.description: CPUC assigns IID customers to SoCalGas for the state-funded AB 209 Residential Solar and Storage Equity budget. The SGIP tracker lists the SoCalGas budget as Waitlist on 2026-09-30. This is a conditional storage incentive program, not confirmation of available funding.
value.eligibility: Income-qualified residential customers; solar must be paired with eligible energy storage. Individual eligibility, program requirements and a funding reservation must be confirmed with the assigned program administrator.

battery_programs.notes: SoCalGas is the CPUC-assigned incentive administrator for IID customers, not a claim about gas service at a property. The schema has no waitlisted status, so status is unknown; amounts and award dates remain null.

required_documents.notes: SolarAPP+ approval still requires a city permit application.

value: Track the permit and schedule inspections in city CSS.

timeline_days.notes: SolarAPP+ automated review does not establish a total permit or interconnection deadline.

other_conditions: PV systems must be less than 38.4 kW; the page does not specify AC or DC.
Outside special districts, historic neighborhoods, environmentally sensitive areas and hillside development zones.

eligibility_constraints.notes: AC and DC limits stay null because the city's threshold does not identify its electrical basis.

permit_fees.notes: Current solar fees were not verified; comparison tables and proposed amounts were not used.

value.name: Self-Generation Incentive Program — Residential Solar and Storage Equity, solar component (waitlisted)
value.description: The state-funded AB 209 Residential Solar and Storage Equity program includes a solar incentive paired with energy storage for qualifying low-income households. CPUC assigns IID customers to SoCalGas; that budget is Waitlist on the current SGIP tracker. This solar component is not a standalone solar rebate or a separate award from the paired storage program.
value.eligibility: Income-qualified residential customers; solar must be paired with eligible energy storage. Individual eligibility, program requirements and a funding reservation must be confirmed with the assigned program administrator.

rebates.notes: Solar component of the same paired RSSE program identified in battery_programs. The current tracker lists Waitlist; inclusion does not establish an available funding reservation. The schema has no waitlisted status; no dollar amount or award date is asserted.

official_contacts.notes: City contact for revisions that leave SolarAPP+ eligibility.
